state.description: continue: send chunk next_chunk_index of this upload next. installed: the package with digest is installed; stop. busy: another upload, or the sidecar's own download, is in flight; retry later. refused: this upload is not accepted; reason says why; do not retry it. Clients treat an unknown value as refused.

reason.description: With refused: not_offered, not_eligible, verification or storage. Clients treat an unknown value as final for this upload.
